summary: Searches the global vehicle array for an entry whose name matches a caller-provided string. Iterates entries at stride 1060 from the array base dword_8AC394, reads each entry's name pointer (falling back to the default string byte_5EA438 when null), and compares it against the search name via sub_588410, which returns 0 on a match. Stores the matching entry index into dword_8AC38C. Returns without writing when the search name is null, the entry count dword_8AC390 is not positive, or no match is found within the count.

operations.description: When the search name a1 is null, return without any lookup.
Initialize the candidate index v1 to 0.
Only iterate when the entry count dword_8AC390 is greater than 0.
Iterate over vehicle entries, advancing by stride 1060 bytes from the array base dword_8AC394.
Load the entry name pointer at (i + dword_8AC394); when null, substitute the default string byte_5EA438.
Compare the entry name against the search name a1 via sub_588410, which returns 0 on a match.
Break out of the iteration on a match; if the incremented index v1 reaches dword_8AC390 first, return without storing.
Store the matching entry index v1 into dword_8AC38C.

unresolved: Exact comparison semantics of sub_588410 (case sensitivity, partial vs full match) beyond returning 0 on match.
The layout of each 1060-byte vehicle entry; only the leading name pointer is observed.
Meaning of the default string byte_5EA438 used as a fallback for null entry names.
